meta.purpose: Evaluate end-to-end autonomous discovery of an unlisted toolchain (Go 1.26 on Windows), probe execution, LIN-IR backend emission, semantic verification against canonical oracle, performance benchmarking, knowledge ledger persistence, and autonomous selection in future workloads
meta.hypothesis: O LIN é capaz de descobrir autonomamente uma nova toolchain no host, sintetizar um backend funcional, verificar equivalência semântica estrita, registrar o perfil no ledger de conhecimento e selecionar esse backend em decisões futuras de compilação sem intervenção manual e sem alterar o núcleo protegido.

phases.name: LIN-IR to Discovered Backend Code Emission
Autonomous Selection in Subsequent Workload Task

gates.GATE_DISCOVERY_INTEGRITY: Toolchain discovered and verified on host
gates.GATE_EMISSION_AND_VERIFY: Emitted code compiles and Output == Oracle
gates.GATE_KNOWLEDGE_PERSISTENCE: Empirical profile saved to knowledge ledger
gates.GATE_FUTURE_SELECTION: Autonomous selector chooses discovered backend for its domain
